OPTION_RUNEPRIEST_ETCH.name: Etch
OPTION_RUNEPRIEST_ETCH.description: Remove a rune card from your deck and [gold]Etch[/gold] its runes onto your [gold]Eternal Scroll[/gold]. The Scroll costs 1 more.
OPTION_RUNEPRIEST_ETCH.descriptionDisabl: You need an [gold]Eternal Scroll[/gold] and another rune card in your deck to [gold]Etch[/gold].
